name: python-monotonic-stack
title: Monotonic Stack
blurb: monotonic stack: next greater, next smaller, and previous greater elements are found by popping while the new value breaks the order; oversized or malformed inputs are named, never stacked.
default_description: A monotonic-stack toolkit whose next-greater answers match a naive scan on every small list, whose audit counts are consistent, and whose oversized or malformed inputs are named, never stacked.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a monotonic stack pops while the new value breaks the order
